Begin with every pile nonsquare at cost sum(cn); making exactly half square costs the sum of n/2 smallest(cq-cn). cq comes from integer isqrt neighbors; cn is0 for existing nonsquares,2 for zero,1 for other squares. This global min-cost assignment differs from worker surplus/deficit branches.
